description: Code-behind for ShowAns.aspx page in an online examination system; handles displaying and submitting student answers and marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for ShowAns.aspx, manages displaying student answers and submitting marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Loads student answers from database and displays them on the page when the page is loaded.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates database with submitted marks, removes student from queue, and redirects to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
